title: Test oracle comment claims RFC wire format but uses snake_case
description: In crate-jmap-types/src/query.rs, filter_operator_or_roundtrip comments 'Wire format taken verbatim from RFC 8620 §5.5 (the Todo/query example).' But the JSON uses snake_case 'has_keyword' not camelCase 'hasKeyword'. RFC 8620 §5.5 uses {"hasKeyword":"music"}. The Cond struct lacks rename_all=camelCase so both struct and JSON are internally consistent — but the oracle claim is false. filter_condition_deserialization has the same issue. Fix: either add rename_all=camelCase to Cond and fix JSON, or correct the comment.
